Surya Namaskar consists of a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas and is best performed early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001]. 

Ek complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left, with each posture coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom Pranayama ke fayde hain ki yeh mind ko calm karta hai aur stress relieve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein madad karta hai, aur patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Start karne ke liye 5-10 rounds se shuru karein [PROG_P_001].

Healthy lifestyle ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai jisme carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, aur minerals ka mix ho [PROG_D_001]. 

Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli lein [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jiske liye khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry ek accha option hai [PROG_D_001]. 

Seasonal fruits aur vegetables include karein, aur din mein kam se kam 8-10 glasses of paani piyein [PROG_D_001]. Processed sugar aur excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. Cravings ke liye nuts aur seeds se snack karna ek acha tarika hai [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit with a straight spine and pump your stomach inwards with each short, powerful breath, starting with 20-30 pumps and up to 3 rounds [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates digestion, improves metabolic rate, and aids weight loss [PROG_P_002]. 

Perform it on an empty stomach in the morning [PROG_P_002]. Avoid it if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana (Triangle Pose) is a foundational standing pose where you stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees and left foot in slightly, extend your torso to the right from the hips, place your right hand on your shin, ankle, or floor, and extend your left arm up [PROG_Y_003].

It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine while strengthening the legs and core, is therapeutic for stress, and improves digestion [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds, but avoid locking your knees and avoid the pose if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. 

Iske liye comfortable baithiye, tongue ko tube shape mein roll karke mouth se bahar nikalye, aur tube ke through slowly and deeply inhale kariye [PROG_P_004]. Phir tongue ko retract karke mouth close kariye aur nostrils se slowly exhale kariye [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat kariye [PROG_P_004]. 

Yeh body aur mind ko cool karta hai, aur mental and emotional excitation ko reduce karta hai [PROG_P_004]. 

*Note: Yeh low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale logo ke liye recommended nahi hai [PROG_P_004]. Clean environment mein practice kariye [PROG_P_004].*

Immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet lena zaroori hai [PROG_D_002]. Apni diet mein citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons shamil karein kyunki yeh Vitamin C se rich hote hain aur immunity boost karte hain [PROG_D_002]. Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, jo anti-inflammatory compound hai; ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002]. 

Ginger aur garlic bhi medicinal properties ke liye acche hain [PROG_D_002]. Yogurt gut health ke liye probiotics ka great source hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se packed hain, aur almonds Vitamin E ka great source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience who began his journey in Rishikesh learning from traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment and breath [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga to help manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants, serving as a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle [PROG_D_004]. 

Different varieties offer specific benefits: Ragi (Finger Millet) provides calcium for bone health, Jowar (Sorghum) is packed with iron and protein, and Bajra (Pearl Millet) is rich in magnesium for heart health [PROG_D_004]. Their high fiber content aids weight management, and their low glycemic index makes them suitable for diabetics [PROG_D_004].

You can relax with Shavasana (Corpse Pose) by lying flat on your back with feet apart and arms by your sides, palms up, for 5-10 minutes to reduce blood pressure and combat insomnia [PROG_Y_004]. 

Another option is Balasana (Childs Pose), where you kneel, sit back on your heels, and fold forward with your forehead on the floor for 30 seconds to a few minutes to relieve stress and fatigue [PROG_Y_005]. 

If you need further guidance, would you like me to connect a care coordinator?

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She follows a no-deprivation approach and creates sustainable diet plans that fit your lifestyle and cultural eating habits [PROG_I_002]. She specializes in personalized meal plans based on Indian cuisine and offers one-on-one consultations on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health [PROG_D_003]. Water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, more if you exercise or its a hot day [PROG_D_003]. Drinking water before meals can aid in weight management, and it is essential for kidney function and flushing out toxins [PROG_D_003].
